power.method: PoE (802.3at, Type 2, Class 4), max. 22.8W, or 12 VDC max. 19.2W

features: DeepinViewX 4MP motorized-varifocal (P-iris) bullet with dedicated Guanlan large-scale AI model for perimeter protection (~90% fewer false alarms)
AI Encoding — cuts storage ~50% while preserving human/vehicle image quality
multi-target-type detection — simultaneous human body, face and vehicle capture with feature extraction
face capture, regional people counting, heat map, on/off duty detection, AcuSeek search (with AcuSeek NVR/servers)
perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance/exiting
AI Open Platform — 4 loadable model packages, up to 16 target types each
hybrid supplement light — IR up to 100m (8-32mm) / 80m (2.8-12mm), white light up to 60m
140 dB WDR, DarkFighter 2.0 low-light, built-in front window heater

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

release_notes: 4MP DeepinViewX motorized-varifocal (P-iris, 2.8-12mm or 8-32mm) bullet for perimeter protection (Guanlan model) with face capture, people counting, heat map, AI Encoding. 4MP sibling of the iDS-2CD5A86G2/V-XZHSY. -H heater, -Y NEMA 4X.
